description: This file contains Go source code for the 'openapi' package in Kubernetes, including functions for generating and managing OpenAPI specifications, such as operation ID generation, route handling, and type naming.

classes.name: groupVersionKinds
classes.description: A slice of GroupVersionKind with methods for sorting and JSON serialization.

classes.name: DefinitionNamer
classes.description: A struct to customize OpenAPI definition names based on type and version information.

methods.name: ToValidOperationID
methods.description: Converts a string into a valid operation ID by removing punctuations, whitespaces, and converting to camel case.

methods.name: GetOperationIDAndTags
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID and associated tags for a given RESTful route to prevent duplicates in OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: gkvConvert
methods.description: Converts a schema.GroupVersionKind to a v1.GroupVersionKind.

methods.name: NewDefinitionNamer
methods.description: Creates a new DefinitionNamer instance, initializing type to GVK mappings from provided schemes.

methods.name: GetDefinitionName
methods.description: Returns the name and optional GVK extension for a given definition name.
